name: Jetski Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a shark-shaped jet ski with an orange hull, a black band with lens eyes and a toothy shark grin
entry: It skims across lakes pretending to be a shark, and laughs its crackling laugh when swimmers scramble for the shore.
how: Use a Jet Ski Engine on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Draco Meteor in this form.
